description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the MyTimesheetAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It contains setup methods and multiple test cases for creating, retrieving, and updating timesheet entries, as well as handling not implemented methods for getOne, delete, and their validation rules.

classes.name: MyTimesheetAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the MyTimesheetAPI, testing create, getAll, update functionalities, and handling unimplemented methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific tables related to WorkflowStateMachine.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a timesheet entry using the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create test method.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all timesheet entries via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getAll test method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a timesheet entry via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the update test method.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne method; expects a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for getOne; expects a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete method; expects a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for delete; expects a not implemented exception.
